evidence.notes: Local page messages are collected during Visualforce actions and reset between action lifecycles.
Current-page URL and parameter mutation are visible inside local controller invocation.
A local ApexPage SObject record constructs a Visualforce PageReference for /apex/<Name>.
Test.invokePage returns a typed Component.apex.page handle without rendering the Visualforce page.
The local LWC Apex wire bridge serializes controller SObject row responses through the runtime JSON path.

source.content: Controller invocation tests assert current page parameters, ApexPages.addMessage collection, page-message isolation, and preserved PageReference parameter mutation.
Lightning Out bridge tests assert Apex wire SObject rows, label module imports, static-resource URLs, and record wire output from local storage.
